create_pipe_config: create a PipeConfig to apply a function with configurable concurrency and output ordering in a pipeline
create_aggregate_config: create an AggregateConfig to batch incoming items into groups of N or use a custom Aggregator
merge_pipeline_configs: create a MergeConfig to merge multiple pipeline configs into a single output queue with an optional custom merge operation
create_path_variants_config: create a PathVariantsConfig to route items to different processing paths based on a router function
build_pipeline_config: build a PipelineConfig that composes a source, a series of pipe stages, and a sink buffer
